phase.objective: Bootstrap the complete GitHub issue roadmap, compact human-aware agent state, and minimal cross-harness model/reasoning provenance before website implementation, while preserving H02A as the next product-critical qualification phase.
entryCriteria: PR #19 merged at b42c35ac17793fb1621baf19905a0eacea9b3521 and accepted the Podroid-MVP alignment, roadmap truth, static-site, theme, and human-aware planning contracts.
GitHub Issues are enabled, but the reviewed roadmap has not yet been materialized as labels, milestones, stable-ID issues, dependency links, snapshots, or agent commands.
GOAL.md and docs/roadmap/podroid-mvp-alignment.md preserve H02A and the one-phone vertical slice as the product critical path.
H02A implementation has not started and may be paused without discarding code or evidence; it will receive a fresh phase-start review after this bounded foundation.
The phase changes planning infrastructure only and makes no Android, guest, physical-device, release, or acceptance claim.
exitCriteria: A complete reviewed seed covers all roadmap outcomes, B01-B20, U01-U04, release-blocking debt, accepted post-MVP directions, current pull requests, and task-packet mappings.
The provenance slice is limited to Git trailers, a deterministic Git-range report, isolated PR CI, and focused tests; it has no product/runtime coupling or mandatory hook dependency.
An idempotent dry-run/apply bootstrap creates or verifies GitHub labels, milestones, stable-ID issues, and complete issue-dependency links without overwriting live refinements.
The normalized live graph generates a bounded last-known-good public snapshot and compact agent index with source hash, freshness, fallback, and partial-graph protections.
Bounded status, freshness, sync, and per-issue context entry points are tested and documented with human-visible state and disagreement reporting.

New project-owned commits in a validated pull-request range carry explicit model, reasoning, run, task, and mode metadata, and PR CI publishes a bounded deterministic report without mutating the repository tree.
All WEB04 criteria and normal repository checks pass, and no website page or product implementation is introduced.
A phase-end review normally reactivates H02A and may authorize WEB01 in parallel only when paths remain disjoint and the live roadmap/index is healthy.
